case.title: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
case.briefing: The new PX pump series needs shaft SH-220 (1.4021). Two suppliers quote: a German job shop and a Polish machining company. Lead time must not exceed 42 days; the line needs parts within 35 days, every day later costs EUR 150. Machined shafts are a leverage category: several capable suppliers, the goal is the lowest total cost. Award one.

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
message.body:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your proposed options, but changing the delivery to DAP and reducing the lead time to 35 days adds significant freight and production costs.

If DAP and 35 days lead time are strictly required, our current proposal is a price of €17.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP. We would need to revise the price upwards to cover these additional expenses. Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL.

To support your cost targets, we propose maintaining EXW delivery and a 45-day lead time, which allows us to reduce our price to EUR 15.80. This alternative is a price of €15.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 45 days, delivery EXW at our standard terms.

This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
